answer: Agents stake bonded identities whose synchrophasor-style attestations must agree across independent wide-area monitors, so a sybil swarm cannot fake coherent inertia without broadcasting a detectable phase signal. Each node cross-checks the returning echo of its state estimate against a quorum anchored at a trusted jetty, rejecting clusters whose correlation collapses under. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
